sources.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: EIA applies only where project type, scale, sensitivity and likely significant effects meet the regulatory tests; no sample project is assumed EIA development.

sources.title: Environmental Outcomes Reports: a new approach to environmental assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The reform programme describes a future outcomes-based system while existing assessment regimes remain relevant until replacement rules commence.

sources.title: Environmental Outcomes Reports: Roadmap to reform
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The roadmap is transition-policy context and is not treated as a completed candidate environmental assessment.

sources.title: Post Implementation Review: Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The statutory review evaluates the EIA regulations and recommends replacement; it does not remove project-specific screening duties by itself.

sources.title: Post Implementation Review: Infrastructure Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Infrastructure EIA review findings are regulatory context, not evidence that a candidate is nationally significant infrastructure or EIA development.

sources.title: Screening neighbourhood plans for Strategic Environmental Assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: SEA screening is plan-specific and considers likely significant environmental effects and sensitive areas; generic geography is insufficient.

sources.title: Appropriate assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Habitats Regulations appropriate assessment depends on likely significant effects on protected sites and a competent-authority assessment.

sources.title: Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations: public register
sources.verified_claim: The public register records specific agricultural EIA screening and consent decisions; register existence does not bind any sample parcel without an exact case match.
